rationale: No displayed earlier directive plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting template for the child. C21 is strongest because it directs agencies to reexamine programs, reduce resource use, and report through a central follow-up mechanism, which loosely resembles the child's government-wide staff reductions and continued review. C02 likewise emphasizes continuing scrutiny of Defense activities and adjustment to changing conditions, while C19 shares a reply-to-an-official structure, balance-of-policy discussion, and concern for an incoming successor. These similarities remain generic or context-driven; none shows distinctive shared language, a sufficiently parallel operative sequence, or substantially the same administrative machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: all departments of the government are under instructions to continue to examine the size of their staffs abroad and the number of their dependents accompanying these staffs with the objective of making further reductions wherever possible
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Please reexamine your programs, giving particular attention... [to] deferring, curtailing, or slowing down those projects which do not directly contribute to defense
shared_material.explanation: C21 contains the closest government-wide review-and-reduction mechanism, but it concerns conserving defense resources and uses ordinary administrative language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: my Directive has been viewed as one that should appropriately be under close and continued review, and at my direction specific follow-up procedures are in effect
shared_material.parent_excerpt: To reach such figures without injuring our combat strength will require continuing close scrutiny of all defense elements
shared_material.explanation: C02 shares continued scrutiny of defense measures and concern about preserving military effectiveness, but not the child's specific balance-of-payments review machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I approve your recommendation to acquaint your successor with your [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] and this reply
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am doing all that I can to assure an orderly transition of the heavy responsibilities of Government to the new Administration
shared_material.explanation: C19 also addresses an outgoing administration's handling of a policy matter affecting its successor, but its operative decision and extensive wage-stabilization analysis do not parallel the child.
